This is done with the help of an iron support. -nürᵘ̈ f. the cross beam on the top of a columnar support, the capitol of a pillar. --ʦônᵘ-motᵘ -- perf. part. (f. --ʦöñᵘ̈-müʦᵘ̈ --), (of a sunken house) raised up and supported on struts; (of some one afflicted or distressed) helped, comforted. --ʦānun -- m.inf. to introduce supports, to elevate or support a falling house or the like by the introduction of pillars or struts; to give help to some one afflicted or sick.

card. (pl. dat. pandāhan), fifteen (Gr.Gr. 76). ¶ pandöhⁱ, the form taken by pandāh as a multiplicative, as in kāh pandöhⁱ akh hath ta pönʦahaiṭh, eleven fifteens are a hundred and sixty-five (Gr.Gr. 86). ¶ pandāhan-hondᵘ adj. (f. -hünzᵘ̈), of, or belonging to, fifteen; costing fifteen (rupees, pice, etc.).

m. a Pāṇḍava, one of the five heroes of the Skt. Mahābhārata. Their mothers' names were Kuntī and Mādrī (L.V. 97; K.Pr. 47; Śiv. 710, 853; K. 533, 537, 541-2, 546, 689, 699, 1001, 1011, 1017; K.Pr. 47, 243). See pānḍu.

m. (sg. dat. pȧnḍitas; his wife is pȧnḍⁱtöñⁱ, q.v.), a pandit, a man learned in Sanskrit and similar Hindū studies (cf. pȧrⁱ-pⁱ) (Gr.Gr. 39, 142; W. 17, pundit; L.V. 3; Rām. 85, 1587; K. 944, 990, 991); a Kāshmīrī Brāhmaṇ, a man of the Brāhmaṇ caste (cf. pŏnasan-pᵒ, p. 742a, l. 3) (Śiv. 240). pȧnḍith-bāy f. a pundit's lady, the wife of an influential and well-to-do pandit. -dachin f. a pandit's fee. -koṭᵘ m. the son of a pandit (esp. a worthy son), a son of pandits, i.e. a worthy young pandit.
f. the condition or profession of a pandit.

m. N. of the putative father of the five Pāṇḍavas (see pānḍav). He was the husband of their mothers, Kuntī and Mādrī. The former had three sons,--Yudhiṣṭhira, Bhīma, and Arjuna,--by the gods, Dharma, Vāyu, and Indra respectively. Mādrī had two sons--Nakula and Sahadēva--by the two Aśvins. pānḍu-rāza m., id. (K. 539, 540).

adv. sorrowfully, dejectedly, with disappointment, full of regrets, regretfully (u.w. vbs. indicating achievement and the like) (K.Pr. 204); cf. ponᵘ 2. --kaḍun -- m.inf. to draw out sorrowfully, i.e. to distress a person who has been enjoying himself, to turn another's pleasure into sorrow. --nērun -- m.inf. to issue sorrowfully, i.e. (after having achieved some pleasant object, that object) to lose all flavour (owing to an access of fear, sorrow, or other disturbing element), to turn to ashes in the mouth, to become a Dead Sea apple. Cf. pȧnⁱ nērun, p. 737b, l. 17.
f. acting as a pandit (even if not learned), thinking oneself to be a pandit (Gr.Gr. 142).
f. a pandit's wife (Gr.Gr. 39; W. 17, punditönⁱ).
f. panditship, the learning which constitutes a man's right to be called a pandit (Gr.Gr. 143); the profession of a pandit (i.e. teaching and the like), a paṇḍit's livelihood.
m. selfness, treating another as oneself. Cf. pāna.
f. a female water-carrier. Cf. pāñurᵘ.

f. (sg. dat. pangüʦᵘ̈), a line, file, line of men, animals, trees, separate letters, or the like; a line (in writing) (Gr.M.); a line of descendants, straight descent, lineage; a body of fellows (such as people of one caste or of one religion, or a body of students, or the like). Cf. pankᵃth.
(? spelling and gender), in aree-ʦar pangrai (L. 463), the first of the four weedings of a rice field (? pana-grāy).
m. a marriage ceremony, a wedding, marriage (K. 666).
m. a marriage ceremony, a wedding, marriage; pānigrahanas yiñᵘ̈, (of a woman) to become wedded (K. 774).
f. the occupation of a water-carrier.
card. five. A Persian word used in the following:-- --mewa -- (= پنج میوہ) m. 'the five fruits' (almonds, coconuts, pistachios, jalgōza (q.v.), and dates). -shĕmba پنجشنہ m. Thursday (W. 107).

m. an aggregate of five; a five (in cards, on dice, or the like); the hand with the five fingers extended (cf. atha-pᵒ, p. 61b, l. 2) (Gr.M.); the paw or claw of beast or bird (Gr.M.; Rām. 410, 601, 697-8, 703; H. xii, 16-17). --dyunᵘ -- m.inf. 'to give the five', i.e. to strike with the five fingers, to scratch with the five finger-nails or (of a wild beast) to tear with the claws. -ʦoṭᵘ adj. (f. -ʦüṭᵘ̈), one whose fingers, toes, or claws have all been cut off (of man, beast, or bird).
m. N. of the Land of the Five Rivers, the Panjāb (Rām. 1198).

m. a cage (Gr.M., Rām. 19, K.Pr. 167); a lattice door, a door of ornamental lattice-work, a lattice window-shutter, a window (YZ. 563); lattice-work (L. 461, pinjara); a skeleton (cf. panzur). -bīn f. the ornamented flange or wooden strip covering the crack between the two halves of a double lattice door or double window-shutter when shut. -chān m. a lattice carpenter. -körⁱ f. emaciation, extreme leanness. -körⁱ gaʦhünᵘ̈ f.inf. to become an emaciated skeleton; hence, to become imprisoned (the result of which is emaciation), to have a dwelling which is like a prison. -körī f. a lattice-worker, a man who makes lattices. -poṭᵘ m. one leaf of a lattice door. -tākh پنجرہ طاق m. a pair of window-lattices.
f. a bird's talon (El.); the five fingers (El. panjih, cf. panja; W. 114, panji).

f. a dainty dish composed of five (pan) ingredients (clarified butter, honey, areca nut, cumin-seed, etc.) (L. 259, panjiri), caudle. It is consumed in the house of a rich man on the occasion of a son's birth.

f. (sg. dat. pankᵘ̈ʦᵘ̈), a line, file, line (of men, animals, trees, separate letters, or the like); a line (in writing) (Gr.M.); a line of descendants, straight descent, lineage; cf. pangath. --navüñᵘ̈ -- f.inf. descendants to multiply, the having many descendants. --ʦhĕnüñᵘ̈ -- f.inf. descendants to be cut off, a family to die out.
m. watery (esp. of food or the like), sloppy, naturally full of water.

adj. (f. panüñᵘ̈), of, or belonging to, self, own (one's, his, etc.). This word, like the Hindī apnā, always refers to the subject of the sentence (Gr.Gr. 91, 141, 152; Gr.M.; Śiv. 624, etc.; Rām. 220, etc.; H. x, 6; xi, 10; K.Pr. 163, 164). According to grammarians, this word is looked upon as the gen. of pāna, q.v.; my own (L.V. 3, 82, 85, 104; Śiv. 41, 73, 178, 341, etc.; Rām. 91, 234, 299; H. iii, 1; iv, 7; vii, 21-2, 26; x, 12; xii, 22; K.Pr. 163); our own (Śiv. 83, 1279, 1752; H. x, 12); thine own (L.V. 55, 57; Śiv. 161, 481, 486, 630, etc.; Rām. 13, 15, 17, 43-4, etc.; H. ii, 9, 11; iii, 2, 9; v, 1, 10; vi, 6, etc.; YZ. 81, 189; K.Pr. 163); your own (H. x, 1); his own (L.V. 45; Śiv. 123, 902, 904-5, etc.; Rām. 78, 107, 220, 239, etc.; K. 210, 241, 378, etc.; H. ii, 5, 7, 11; v, 1, 4, 9, etc.); her own (Rām. 1319; K. 271, 643; H. iii, 2, 4; v, 5, 8-10, 12, etc.; YZ. 76, 249; K.Pr. 164); their own (Śiv. 1030, 1356; Rām. 711, 1397, 1424, 1536; H. v, 10; viii, 1, 5, 11; x, 5; xii, 8). --āsun -- m.inf. to become one's own, to become independent (Rām. 1148). --pān -- m. one's own body, one's own self (cf. panani pānücᵘ̈ khabar, p. 391a, l. 20) (Gr.M.; L.V. 62, 82, 85; Śiv. 235, 278, 362, 492, 578, 1211; Rām. 401, 499, 824, 1135, 1422, 1453, 1536, 1703; K.Pr. 86). --pān rachun -- m.inf. to keep one's own self, to keep one's temper, to make the best of a difficulty, to show stoicism. ¶ panȧni pāna adv. of one's own self, spontaneously; in one's own person (Śiv. 651, 1280). ¶ panañĕ jāyĕ adv. in one's own place; hence, secretly, privately (Rām. 1579).

m. (f. pāñĕrĕñ, a female water-carrier; his wife is pāñirⁱ-bāy, bel.); a water-carrier (Rām. 583; K.Pr. 145, pánúr). ¶ pāñirⁱ-bāy f. a water-carrier's wife. -pônᵘ the occupation or profession of a water-carrier. -paĩsa m. a water-carrier's earnings; met. very humble earnings.
a jingle of anwār, in anwār panwār, p. 36a, l. 34.
m. N. of an important village lying to the north-east of Śrīnagar, described as about eight miles from the Ḍal lake, on the lower slopes of the hill-country.
adj. c.g. (a cloth) of which the warp consists of five hundred threads.

adj. (f. pānzashiñᵘ̈), that which, when weighed or measured, amounts to a pānzuwᵘ or six pounds (= three seers) (Gr.Gr. 147); a vessel which will hold that amount or in which that amount may be cooked.
m. the weight of a pānzuwᵘ, q.v., or six pounds (El.). Cf. pānzashunᵘ.
m. the wound made by an animal's claw (cf. panja) (K. 678).
m. a doll, puppet, in āḍiji-pᵒ, p. 14a, l. 40.
m. in gōjĕ-panzulᵘ, i.q. pĕnzulᵘ, q.v.
m. a skeleton (cf. kāñi-pᵒ, p. 460b, l. 42, and panjara).
m. six pounds weight or measure of something (= three seers) (El. pánzú; Gr.Gr. 147; K.Pr. 136, 165). Cf. man 3.

pönʦ or pã̄ʦh or pö̃ʦh card. five (Gr.Gr. 11, 76, 83; Gr.M.; L.V. 77, 95; K.Pr. 47; Śiv. 516, 710, 853, 914, 1520; Rām. 1768; K. 1011; H. viii, 10; x, 1, 2, 6, 14); a collection of five things, a five. --hath -- card. (pl. dat. --hatan --), five hundred (Gr.M., K. 824); five pice (cf. hath, p. 357b, l. 3) (Gr.Gr. 85). --tŏth -- m.pl. (Śiv. 1498, 1831), i.q. panʦa-tatŏ, l. 6 ab. ¶ pönʦa-bôgᵘ adj. (f. -böjᵘ̈), consisting of five portions or shares. -dolᵘ adj. (f. -düjᵘ̈), (of paddy or the like) pounded (i.e. husked) five times; (of a board or the like) shaved or smoothed five times; (of a field or the like) consisting of five parts. -dôrᵘ adj. (f. -dörᵘ̈), possessing five side-doors or five windows. -gan or -gunᵘ adj. (f. -güñᵘ̈), fivefold, multiplied by five (W. 105, panʦguṇ). -gorᵘ adj. (f. -gürᵘ̈), (of a place, village, or the like) consisting of five houses. -grishᵘ̈ f. a conjunction of five unlucky planets (grah 2); met. a sudden attack of calamities (such as terror from foes, disease, etc.) all round one. -grishᵘ̈ mēlüñᵘ̈ f.inf. to be surrounded by calamities. -grishᵘ̈ wŏthüñᵘ̈ f.inf. calamities to arise all round one. -gavy m. the five products of the cow (i.e. milk, butter, clarified butter, urine, and cowdung, used in purificatory ceremonies). -khorᵘ adj. (f.-khürᵘ̈), (of a field) capable of bearing a crop of five khorᵘ, each of two sheaves (see khorᵘ 3) (a lôwᵘ is as much paddy in stalk as can be grasped in the hand; six lôwᵘ = one gë̆ḍᵘ̈, or sheaf; two gë̆ḍᵘ̈ = one khorᵘ. The amount of grain in a lôwᵘ is about three seers); a load of paddy equivalent to five khorᵘ. -khôrᵘ adj. (f. -khörᵘ̈), (a field) producing, or (a load) of, five khārs, or ass's loads (see khār 3). -kôlᵘ adj. (f. -köjᵘ̈ or -köjⁱ), occurring five times, occurring at five separate periods. -köshⁱlad m. (f. -köshⁱladiñ), one who fasts, or does not eat, for five days (cf. köshⁱlad). -lorᵘ adj. (f. -lürᵘ̈), (of a rope, string, garland, or the like) consisting of five strands. -monᵘ or -moñᵘ adj. (f. -müñᵘ̈), weighing five man (of one and a half seers, or three pounds) each; a stone or other weight used for weighing that amount; cf. man 3. -môsᵘ adj. (f. -mösᵘ̈), of five months, five months old; produced after five months. --nö -- m. the figure 5 in the Śāradā character. -pochᵘ adj. (f. -püchᵘ̈), of, or belonging to, five lunar fortnights, e.g.: (of grain or the like) growing in five fortnights; (of a human being) born after five fortnights; the obsequial oblation performed on the expiry of five fortnights (after a death); and so on. -pokhᵘ adj. (f. -püchᵘ̈), possessing five wings; possessing five people on one's side, possessing five allies; (of a feast or the like) attended by members of five sets of relatives. -pūrᵘ adj. (f.-pūrᵘ̈), (of a house) possessing five stories, five-storied; so, (of an ornament or the like) consisting of five pieces one above the other; (of the guests at a feast or the like) in five groups (graded one above the other according to precedence in honour); cf. pōr 1. -pūshᵘ adj. (f. -pūshᵘ̈), (of a plant) bearing five blossoms; (of an ornament or figured cloth) decorated with five knobs, rosettes, figured flowers, or the like; cf. pōsh. -pọ̆tᵘ adj. (f. -pö̆ʦᵘ̈), possessing five sons. -pọ̆thᵒrᵒ or (Gr.Gr. 75) -pŏtur adj. (f. -pŏthᵘ̈rᵘ̈), id. -patᵃr or -patᵘ̈rᵘ̈ f., see panc-patri. -pôwᵘ (f. -pövᵘ̈), weighing five quarters (of a seer); measuring five spans; a weight for weighing five quarters (of a seer); cf. pāv. -rongᵘ adj. (f. -rünjᵘ̈), of five colours; five-coloured; of five different kinds. -rŏpayyunᵘ adj. f. (-rŏpayiñᵘ̈), costing five rupees, worth five rupees; earning wages of five rupees. -roṭᵘ adj. (f. -rüṭᵘ̈), cloth of which the warp is in five different equal sets of thread; exchanged for something five times its weight. -ryotᵘ adj. (f. -rë̆ʦᵘ̈), of, or belonging to, five months. -shotᵘ adj. (f. -shüʦᵘ̈), of, or belonging to, five hundred (e.g. a cloth with a warp of five hundred threads, or a person whose wages are five hundred). -shĕtyunᵘ adj. (f. -shĕtiñᵘ̈), worth, or costing, five hundred; having wages amounting to five hundred. -syūrᵘ adj. (f. -sīrᵘ̈), weighing five seers (of, nominally, 2 lbs. each); a weight (for weighing) amounting to five seers. -trokᵘ adj. (f. -trücᵘ̈), weighing or measuring five trakhs (of 9 1/2 lbs. each); (of a field or the like) bearing grain amounting to five trakhs. -wahurᵘ adj. (f. -warishᵘ̈), of, or belonging to, five years, five years old. -taran f. (sg. dat. -tarüñᵘ̈), N. of a certain river of Kashmīr, probably the same as the Pañca-taraṅgiṇī of Sanskrit literature, the joint name of five streams on the route to Amarnāth (see RT.Tr. II, 409) (Śiv. 516). -wokhᵘ adj. (f. -wüchᵘ̈), occurring or used five times (a day or the like). -wôrᵘ adj. (f. -wörᵘ̈), possessing five coverings; (of an action or business) done five times. ¶ pönʦi adv. by fives, five by five (as in pönʦi mŏhari, for five mohars each, Śiv. 1285). --laṭi -- adv. five times. --phiri -- adv., id. --pönʦi -- adv. by fives, in fives, five by five. --ranga -- adv. in five manners, in five different ways, in five kinds. --vizi -- adv. at five times in a single period. ¶ pönʦan-hondᵘ gen.pl. (f. -hünzᵘ̈), of, or belonging to, five; costing five (rupees, etc.). ¶ pǖnʦⁱ-pönʦaway card. a complete group of five, even all five, the entire five. ¶ pönʦay card. only five (Gr.Gr. 83).

or, the Kāshmīrī form of the Sanskrit word pañca, i.q. pānʦ, five, q.v., occurring in Sanskrit compounds, such as the following:-- panʦa-daiwath m. (sg. dat. -daiwatas), (among Hindūs) a certain group of five gods (Dharma, Indra, Vāyu, and the two Aśvins, who were the fathers of the five Pāṇḍavas. The first three begot, respectively, Yudhiṣṭhira, Bhīma, and Arjuna on Kuntī, and the last two Nakula and Sahadēva on Mādrī) (K. 537 ff.); cf. diwatā. -mŏkh the equivalent of Skt. pañca-mukha, five-faced, a title of the god Shiwa (Śiva) (Śiv. 516, 1567). -stavī f. N. of a certain hymn of praise (Śiv. 1498). -tatŏ m.pl. the equivalent of the Skt. pañca-tattva, the five elements taken collectively, i.e. earth, air, heat or light, water, and ether, as a group, i.e. the whole of creation (Śiv. 1033); cf. pönʦ tŏth, l. 14 bel.

card. fifty (El. páṅsah and pántsah; Gr.Gr. 78, 84; Gr.M.); a collection of fifty things, a fifty. ¶ panʦöhⁱ, the form taken by panʦāh, fifty, as a multiplicative, as in kāh panʦöhⁱ pönʦ hath ta panʦāh, eleven fifties (are) five hundred and fifty (Gr.Gr. 86). panʦāhan-hondᵘ (f. -hünzᵘ̈) of, or belonging to, fifty; costing, or worth, fifty rupees; receiving wages amounting to fifty (rupees, etc.).

m. N. of a celebrated pass and (by extension) of a mountain range on the south of the Valley of Kashmīr, the Pañcāla of Skt. and the Pīr Panjāl of Europeans. Also called Pönʦāl (El. panzāl) (see RT.Tr. II, 396 ff.; Śiv. 1637, 1681); N. of an ancient country in India, the Pañcāla of Skt. literature. --kāv -- or pönʦāl kāv m. (f. -köviñ), a certain large and powerful bird looked upon as a kind of crow. It is said to be black in colour and to be able to kill a weak man or animal; met. a dark-natured, greedy, cruel man (or, f., woman).
or pönʦatrᵃh card. thirty-five (Gr.Gr. 77) (El. paintre). pönʦatrᵃhukᵃ adj. (f. pönʦatrᵃhücᵃ), of, or belonging to, or produced in the thirty-fifth year.
or pānʦazañ m. N. of the conch of Krishna (Śiv. 709, 782, 796; K. 491, 492, 495).
adj. c.g. of, or belonging to, or produced in the Panʦāl range; of, or belonging to, the country of India known as Pañcāla.

f. turnips and similar roots dried (by people of the hill country) and kept for consumption in winter (cf. pan 4). -hurᵘ̈ f. a mass of these roots as cooked in soup. -thaph f. (sg. dat. -thapi), a handful of these dried roots. ¶ pañi-ʦar m. a rope of these dried roots (as stored in rope form for keeping).
adj. c.g. possessing the mark of a union or repair (of some article, such as a vessel, an ornament, or a board).
adj. c.g. (as subst., f. pāpaladiñ), admittedly sinful, guilty, faulty (of quality, tribe, action, person, etc.).
m. a kind of thin cake made of grām, flour, and spices, fried crisp.
m. (of a human being, etc.) the upper part of the back of the shoulders.
f. continued fall (e.g. rain) accompanied by noise, the pattering of rain. So also used with reference to continued breaking of wind, or the continued sounds made by shampooing.
f., in ʦũ̄̈ṭa-paparāy, p. 1087a, l. 36, i.q. paparāray, q.v.
f. the time of ripening, the season of ripening, esp. (of grain-crops) harvest-time.
m. the condition of being ripe (of corn, fruit, etc., or a boil, etc.), ripeness (Gr.Gr. 138).

m. (sg. dat. pāpas), sin, vice, crime, wickedness, fault, transgression, guilt (cf. līph-pᵒ, p. 528b, l. 27) (Gr.Gr. 10; Gr.M.; L. 280; L.V. 62; Śiv. 13, 101, 105, 170, 195, 199, 238, 257, etc.; Rām. 29, 53, 60, 172, 239, 241, 297, etc.; K. 12, 329, 848-50, 1092, 1096, 1100, 1174). --khārun -- m.inf. to cause a crime to mount (on a person), to convict (a person) of some crime, to prove him guilty; to bring a charge of sin or crime (against a person). --khasun -- m.inf. sin to mount (on a person), to be stained by sin, to commit sin, to sin (Rām. 1181, 1238, 1596, 1619); a sin, or crime, to be charged (against a person). --warzun -- m.inf. to abandon sin, to be freed from sin (Rām. 1620). Cf. pāpa-warzan, bel. ¶ pāpa-bŏd f. (sg. dat. -bö̆zᵘ̈), an evil mind, a depraved intellect; esp. an evil thought or intention which assails a person hitherto free from such. -bọ̆ḍᵘ adj. (f. -bö̆ḍᵘ̈), sunk in sin, plunged in sinfulness, ungodly, depraved. --bŏḍun -- m.inf. to be plunged in sin, to be utterly depraved. -drav m. food, the eating of which is sinful (e.g. certain spiced meat) (El. pápadráo, flesh, mutton). -drāv adj. c.g. issued from sin, released from the consequences (such as scandal or disease) of sin. -dash f. a skirt of sin, a fringe of sin, pāpa-dashi-sṻty atha-shĕr gaʦhun, accidental contact with a fringe of sin to occur (Rām. 230). -haran m. N. of a sacred spring in Kashmīr (Śiv. 1164). -phal m. the fruit of sin, the consequences (such as disease, etc., or punishment in a future life) of sin. -rostᵘ adj. (f. -rüʦhᵘ̈), sinless (of a person, action, etc.). -warzan f. (sg. dat. -warzüñᵘ̈), becoming disjoined from sin, abandonment of sin; cf. pāph warzun, ab. -vyotᵘ adj. (f. -vë̆ʦᵘ̈), full of sin, full of faults. ¶ pāpukᵘ sg. gen. (f. pāpücᵘ̈), of, or belonging to, sin, or produced by (or resulting from) sin.

conj. 3 (2 p.p. papyōv), to become ripened or matured, to ripen (of corn, fruit, etc., or a boil, etc.) (Gr.M.; L.V. 92; Śiv. 255, 1315; H. ix, 9); to be ripe (of fruit) (El., Gr.M., K.Pr. 119); to become baked (of food, pottery, or the like) (Rām. 1446). ¶ papan-pāṭh m. (of a crop of grain or the like) the being well ripened (i.e. with no blight or other fault), healthy and full ripeness. ¶ papyō-motᵘ perf. part. (f. papyē-müʦᵘ̈), ripened, become ripe.
m. a wooden mattock or hoe (for digging up) (Śiv. 1856); an axe (K.Pr. 231). ¶ para-dab  m. a blow of a hoe; met. a crashing calamity. -ʦünḍᵘ̈ f. (sg. dat. ʦanjĕ) id.
m. the sole of a shoe.
m. a pinion, feather, wing (cf. bombura- par, p. 108a, l. 31) (El., Gr.M., W. 146, L.V. 99, K.Pr. 46; Rām. 411, 532-3, 779; YZ. 558).

m. a reputation for faultiness or for being defective (e.g. of some article because it is damaged, or of some person by calumny, etc.). --anun -- m.inf. to blame (a person on good grounds or in calumny, or some act on the ground that it does not turn out satisfactorily, and so on). --yunᵘ -- m.inf. (of some action or business) reputation or censure for defects to be acquired.

m. a foot (of man, bird, or beast) (i.q. pair, q.v.) (Śiv. 1752; Rām. 409; H. ix, 1). ¶ paran pyō-motᵘ perf. part. (f. --pyē-müʦᵘ̈ --), fallen at a person's feet. --pyonᵘ -- m.inf. to fall at a person's feet, to show great reverence (Rām. 167, 316, 452, 494, 821, 829, 940, 984, 1044, 1143b-d, 1689, 1701; K. 496). --tāñ pāwun -- m.inf. to cause a person to fall at another's feet, to cause a person to prostrate himself in reverence (Rām. 1552). --tal -- adv. under the feet (e.g. of people taking refuge under a god's feet) (Śiv. 1179; Rām. 506, 940, 988, 1219).

m. the further bank, or opposit shore or side (of a river, lake, etc.); the end or limit of anything, termination, conclusion, the utmost limit or extent or reach (cf. dāra-pᵒ, p. 236a, l. 43). --gaʦhun -- m.inf. to go to the opposite shore, to cross over, to go through or over or across or to the end (Śiv. 1793); to master completely, be thoroughly versed in. ¶ pāra pyonᵘ m.inf. to come just when wanted and exactly as wanted, to become perfectly suitable.

adj. c.g. one who is other than oneself, someone else, another (Gr.Gr. 153; L.V. 5, 7; Śiv. 1211, 1241, 1561, 1856; K. 468; K.Pr. 255); highest, greatest, pre-eminent, supreme (Śiv. 1856); (as subst., m.) He who is Supreme, the Supreme Deity (L.V. 59); as adv., thereupon, thereafter (Rām. 563); --˚ having anything as the highest object, engrossed in, intent on, solely devoted to (Śiv. 20, prakrĕti-par, cf. prakrath). -bŏd f. (sg. dat. -bö̆zᵘ̈), someone else's opinion, an opinion contrary to one's own. -bᵃhᵃrᵃ or -buhᵒrᵒ m. (his wife is par-buhᵃ̇rᵃ̇-bāy), a settler from a foreign country, one who has come from a distance and settled in a certain place. -balāy f. damage caused by another's fault. -bö̆zᵘ̈gaʦhun m.inf. to follow another's opinion (esp. when it leads to disaster). -buzⁱ or -buzy adv. into the hands of another. -dag āsüñᵘ̈ f.inf. excessive love or sympathy to be exhibited habitually to others. --dana -- m. another's property (whether in one's own possession on trust or not). -dīn m. a foreign religion (W. 111). -dārukᵘ adj. (f. -dārücᵘ̈), one who habitually rescues or helps others (esp. to his own loss). -hāʦh f. blaming a person with an offence committed by another. -hāʦh yiñᵘ̈ f.inf. to become subject to a charge of an offence committed by another. -hāʦi lagun m.inf. to become entangled in a charge of an offence committed by another. -khāv 1 (for 2, see s.v.) m. one who eats another's food (owing to poverty, greed, or the like). -kijⁱ or -kijᵘ̈ f. 'another peg', i.e. (in a quarrel) calling attention to another's insolence; cf. par-lānz, bel. -küjᵘ̈ gaʦhun m.inf. to go according to another's wishes, to follow another's desires (esp. when this causes loss); cf. the next and para-küjᵘ̈ gaʦhun, bel. -kal f. another's longing; longing for another's possessions or condition; cf. para-kal, bel. -kal aʦüñᵘ̈ f.inf. longing for another's goods to enter; to be filled with ardent covetousness or with envy of another's condition. -kana bōzun m.inf. to listen through another ear, to obtain information at second hand. -lānz m. 'another rod', harm caused by another's fault; the worry and distress caused by having to support another's family; cf. par-kijⁱ, ab. -mahanyuwᵘ m. a stranger (W. 111). -māz m. 'other flesh', i.e. the relationship between the respective children of co-wives; hence, enmity such as ordinarily exists between such people. -pŏrush m. the paramour of a woman. -ʦhaṭh f. (sg. dat. -ʦhaṭi), 'another's blizzard', i.e. suffering for another's crime. -ʦūr m. an outside thief, i.e. a thief, not of the household, who comes from outside and steals. -wŏpakörī adj. c.g. kind to others, beneficent, benevolent (Śiv. 1051). -warzukh m. (sg. dat. -warzakas; f.sg. nom. -warzücᵘ̈), one who habitually does other peoples business or work to the damage of his own. --zĕv -- f. 'an extra tongue', a swelling under the tongue, which is looked upon as a second tongue produced by disease. ¶ para-küjᵘ̈ gaʦhun m.inf. to follow another's advice (esp. with bad results); cf. par-küjᵘ̈ gaʦhun, ab. -kal f. affection for outsiders, instead of for one's own people; cf. par-kal, ab. -pad m. the highest position, the supreme place, the abode of the Supreme Deity, final beatitude (Śiv. 1050, 1659). -ʦhyonᵘ adj. (f. -ʦhë˘ñᵘ̈), cut off from others' help or from others' consolation. ¶ parukᵘ gen. adj. (f. parücᵘ̈), of, or belonging to, another.
m. the act of reducing to fragments, used --˚ as in puʦa-pār, see puʦa. Cf. pāra 1.

adj. distant, remote, used ˚-- in the following nouns of relationship. -dĕd f. a step-mother (used esp. in reference to her hatred to her step-son). -pinzurᵘ m. the daughter's son of a daughter's son or daughter, a kind of great-great-grandson. -pinzürᵘ̈ f. the daughter's daughter of a daughter's son or daughter, a kind of great-great-granddaughter. -puturᵘ m. the son of a son's son, a great-grandson. -putᵘ̈rᵘ̈ f. the daughter of a son's son, a great-granddaughter. -zurᵘ m. the son of a son's daughter, a great-grandson. -zurᵘ̈ f. the daughter of a son's daughter, a great-granddaughter.

adj. c.g. incomplete, not completely full; that portion which is required to complete an amount, a required make-weight; cf. pārsang. --pyō-motᵘ -- perf. part. (f. --pyē-müʦᵘ̈ --), (of some action) uncompleted by some portion; (of a man) one who has lost his helper, requiring a helper. --pyonᵘ -- m.inf. the necessity for a portion to complete something uncompleted to occur.

m. a piece, a fragment. --gaʦhun -- m.inf. to become in fragments, to be broken or torn to pieces (Rām. 163, 996, 1221). -han f. a little piece (YZ. 476). --karȧnⁱ -- m. pl. inf. to make fragments (of something, dat.), to rend, tear to pieces (Rām. 221, 253, 527, 911). --pāra -- پارہ پارہ adj. c.g. and adv. in pieces, in fragments (YZ. 57). pāra pāra gaʦhun m.inf. to become smashed, or broken, to pieces (Rām. 478); to become full of holes. pāra pāra karun m.inf. to break, or smash to pieces; to make full of holes; to tear to pieces (Rām. 1143j).
m. a shortened form of pargana, q.v. (El.).
card. a particular high number, 100,000,000,000,000,000. parādi parād adv. in millions on millions, all of it all together, entirely, completely.
m. (Śiv. 542), i.q. pardīshī, q.v. Cf. also pardīsh.
adj. c.g. subject to another, dependent on another, not independent (Śiv. 1791).
adj. (f. pāradivᵘ̈), consisting of quicksilver, made of quicksilver.

or parilūkh m. (sg. dat. para(ri)lūkas ), the other world, the next world, the future state (Gr.M.; W. 111, parilok; L.V. 75, paralōkh; K. 424, 1106); often contrasted with yiha-lūkh, this world, q.v. parilūkas-pĕṭh adv. for the next world, with a view to the next world (e.g. making gifts to the poor to earn salvation, etc.).

or (L.V. 77) paramu adj. c.g. highest, best, most excellent (Śiv. 496); chief, principal, supreme (L.V. 58); most distant. ¶ parama-ākāsh m. (in Śaiva philosophy) the supreme Ether (Śiv. 1558). -ānand, see paramānand. -ātma, see paramātma. -dām m. the supreme abode, i.e. final beatitude (Śiv. 1659). -gŏr m. the spiritual teacher of a person's spiritual teacher, a guru's guru, a grandfather in religion. -gath f. (sg. dat. -güʦᵘ̈), the way of the Supreme, final beatitude (L.V. 103; Śiv. 19, 102, 1539, 1864). -gyönī adj. c.g. one who has the supreme knowledge (Śiv. 109). -hams m. a Hindū ascetic of the highest order; a religious man who has subdued all his senses by abstract meditation; a title of Shiva (Śiv. 1019). --pad -- m. the supreme position; hence, final beatitude (L.V. 10, 77-79); met. the Supreme Deity, in whom (on gaining final beatitude) the soul is absorbed (L.V. 10, 77, 79). --padavī -- f., i.q. -gath, ab. (Śiv. 320, 1088, 1518, etc.). -shẹ̆khᵃth f. (sg. dat. -shẹ̆khᵘ̈ʦᵘ̈), i.q. -shĕktⁱ (Śiv. 9, 53, 665, 1503, 1659). In Śiv. 9 the Sanskrit feminine paramā is used for param. -shĕktⁱ f. (sg. dat. -shĕkti or -shĕktiyĕ), (in Śaiva philosophy) the energic power of the Supreme Śiva (Śiv. 103, 436, 495, 663, 850, 891, etc.). -shĕnkar m. a N. of Śiva (Śiv. 233). -shiv m. the Supreme Śiva, a title of Śiva in his transcendent form (Śiv. 37, 187, 189, 246, 271, 322, 329, 362, 876, etc.). -sthān m. the place of the Supreme, i.e. the condition of final beatitude (Śiv. 1659).
m. the highest or most sublime truth, true spiritual knowledge, knowledge about the Supreme (Śiv. 286, 929, 969).
or (Śiv. 306) parama-ātma m. the Supreme Self, the Supreme Spirit (Śiv. 30, 162, 169, 235, 237, 284, 922, etc.; K. 508).
m. (an expression borrowed direct from Skt., in which language its gender is neuter), the Supreme Bráhma, the Supreme Deity (Śiv. 233, 361, 904, 1130, 1424; K. 437).
f. the wife of Paramēshŏr, q.v. (Śiv. 1167).
m.pl. in pĕpanza paran, p. 749b, l. 26.

m. concluding a fast, eating or drinking after a fast, breakfast. pāran-ḍūnⁱ m.pl. the walnuts of conclusion of the fast; (at the conclusion of a marriage ceremony) the ten walnuts taken from the bride by the bridegroom, and the ten walnuts taken from the bridegroom by her father. They indicate the assent of both sides to the marriage.
m. reading through, perusal, thorough study (K. 8).
m. a towel (for wiping the limbs or body after washing or bathing).
f. the fee paid to a teacher.

conj. 1 (1 p.p. paranôwᵘ), to cause to read (Gr.M., Śiv. 1749); to teach (Gr.M., K. 486); to have spells recited for the expulsion of a demon or the like (Śiv. 126). paranôwᵘ-motᵘ perf. part. (f. paranövᵘ̈-müʦᵘ̈), caused to be read; caused to read, taught.

or parinda m. a winged creature, a bird (Rām. 545, 779); a kind of long light boat with forty or fifty paddlers. (In the front is a raised seat covered with a canopy in which four persons can sit) (El.; L. 381, 382).
etc., incorr. for pröñᵘ̈, see prônᵘ.
adj. c.g. transcending the transcendent (see par 4), an epithet of the Supreme Deity (Śiv. 1659).
m. a touchstone (for testing precious metals or gems); the philosopher's stone (converting base metal into gold by its touch) (Śiv. 1556, K.Pr. 184).
m. N. of a celebrated sage, the father of Vyāsa, in Skt. Parāśara (K. 1038).
adj. and subst., c.g. an adorer, worshipper (cf. pīr-parast, p. 752b, l. 9).
m. He who is Supreme over the Supreme, the Ultimate Supreme, the Supreme Deity (Śiv. 928, 1588).

m. a drinking goblet. ¶ parawan pôñᵘ shrapun m.inf. the water to evaporate from the cups; hence, to become dried up, to be thoroughly cooked, (of food in the belly) to be thoroughly and entirely digested, (of money, etc.) to be wasted away, entirely spent, and so on.
f. wages paid for studying, a present or fixed allowance made to an industrious student, a scholarship (Gr.Gr. 129).
n.ag. (f. paravüñᵘ̈), a reader, a student, an industrious student, bookworm (W. 112); one who recites, a reciter (Śiv. 1519).
f. proclamation, public announcement (Gr.M.). --diñᵘ̈ -- f.inf. to make proclamation by beat of drum.
f. tying or plaiting the hair (cf. mas-pᵒ, p. 595b, l. 32).
m. the principal, or highest, object, the chief aim (Rām. 1729).
m. defeat (e.g. in battle, in a disputation, or in a game).

m. one of the lunar days of the four changes of the moon, viz. the eighth and fourteenth of each lunar fortnight, and the days of the full and new moon; any particular occasion of the year (e.g. when the sun enters a new sign). ¶ parba-dŏh m. the solar day corresponding to one of the above. -dĕn m., id. -kāl m. the time or period of one of these changes.

or parbuth m. (sg. dat. parbatas), a mountain, a hill, a mountain range (Gr.M.; Śiv. 428, 664, 917, 962, 1136, 1221, 1302; Rām. 314, 457, 464, 471, 474, 480, 500, etc.); esp. the hill known as 'Hāra-parbuth' (p. 344a, l. 44, q.v.) near Śrīnagar (Śiv. 952, 1179, 1500, 1505, 1510; K. 182, 322, 326-7, 390, 434, 597, 629, 631, 887).
m. a slip of paper, a scrap of paper. --wālȧnⁱ -- m.pl. inf. to bring down strips, to cut off all round the end of a garment or the like so as to shorten it.

m. (sg. dat. parcanas), the clasp of an earring or the like. parcan-wôlᵘ m. the male, or hooked, member of such a clasp; a certain carpenter's tool (? a kind of chisel). parcan-wöjⁱ or -wöjᵘ̈ f. the female member, or hole, of such a clasp.

m. a curtain, screen, veil, cover (cf. ȧchⁱ-pⁱ, p. 8b, l. 22) (Śiv. 1807; YZ. 32, 159); screen, shelter, pretext; seclusion, concealment; secrecy, privacy, modesty. --karun -- m.inf. to conceal, hide, draw the curtain or screen over (H. vi, 4); (out of affection, etc.) to hide, or conceal, another's misconduct; (of some threatened misfortune or the like) to be stopped. --pakun -- m.inf. (in poverty, bankruptcy, or the like) to carry on one's occupation (household affairs, rule of a kingdom, or the like) without divulging one's necessities. -pūshī پردہ پوشی f. concealment (of a blemish, poverty, etc.); conniving at (a fault or offence); keeping one's secret; preserving confidence; warding off a threatened danger. --rachun -- m.inf. to conceal a thing (from), to keep one's secret, conceal (another's misconduct); to relate a matter in such terms as to be understood by part only of the hearers, to give obscure hints; to ward off a threatened danger. --rōzun -- m.inf. concealment to abide, i.e. concealment (of another's misconduct, one's own poverty, bankruptcy, etc.) to subsist (Rām. 1246). --thawun -- m.inf. to hide another's misconduct. --tulun -- m.inf. to raise the curtain; to unveil, expose, lay bare, reveal. --wŏthun -- m.inf. to become unveiled, etc.; to be revealed, exposed, laid bare; (esp. a merchant's poverty) to be exposed (by rival merchants).
adj. c.g. furnished with a veil or screen (of a doorway), furnished with a permanent 'purda'; confidential, secret.
f. the being furnished with a screen, (of some misconduct, blame, misfortune, or the like) the being provided with concealment.
or paradīsh m. a foreign country (Gr.M.; W. 111, pardēs; Rām. 421; K.Pr. 180).
adj. c.g. a foreigner, a traveller from a foreign country (El. pardeshí, a traveller).
f.pl. in parĕ phuṭañĕ f.pl. inf. (in the execution of some work) power to be destroyed (i.e. loss of resources, helpers, support, etc.). --yiñĕ -- f.pl. inf. power (as ab.) to come.

or (Rām.) paraishān adj. c.g. dispersed, scattered; dishevelled, tossed (as hair) (Rām. 183, YZ. 65); amazed, distracted, perplexed, distressed (Rām. 1021). --karun -- m.inf. to scatter, to perplex, puzzle (El.).
m. a subdivision of a district consisting of a number of villages, a 'pergunnah', about equivalent to an English barony (H. xi, 5, pargan, m.c.).
m. abstaining from, keeping aloof from, abstention (Rām. 29, 37); abstemiousness (Gr.M.); caution, moderation (Gr.M.); a regimen (for an invalid) (Rām. 871, met.).
adj. c.g. (of food for an invalid) suitable for a regimen.
adj. c.g. (as subst., f. parhēzaladiñ), subject to a regimen, on invalid diet.
f. discrimination, acting after close and thorough inspection.

f. a fairy (Rām. 328, 331, 352, 520, 570, 654, 863, 1073, 1175; H. iii, 7, 8; xii, 7, 8, 11, 14, 15, 20, 25; K.Pr. 50). parī-zāth (= پری زاد) or (Rām. 1033) pariyĕ-zāth f. (sg. dat. -zöʦᵘ̈), a woman of the fairy tribe, a fairy, or fairy-like woman (Rām. 408, 1033).

m. (sg. dat. parīkshitas), N. of a celebrated king, grandson of the Pāṇḍava Arjuna. It was to him that it is said that the Bhāgavata Purāṇa was first recited by Śukadēva. The Kali Yuga, i.e. present, or iron, age, is said to have commenced with his reign in 3102 B.C. (K. 5, 9).
m., i.q. parmāna, q.v. (cf. dĕna-pᵒ, p. 22b, l. 45).
m. (sg. dat. paripāpas), the whole collection of a certain person's faults or sins (esp. in cataloguing such when making a formal accusation) (Rām. 1592).
or paripūran adj. c.g. filled (Gr.M.); full (of a flood or tide) (Gr.M.); full (of the moon) (Śiv. 1574).
m. a train, retinue, attendants, followers (collectively) (Śiv. 909; K. 762, 784, 786, 873, 940, 1006).

m. (pārizātas), (in Hindū legend) N. of one of the five trees of Paradise (it was in possession of Indra, from whom it was wrested by Krishna) (Śiv. 497, 1553; Rām. 602; K. 583, 772-3, 775, 777, 924, 970).

m. dexterity, clever-handedness, expertness, proficiency (in any work or employment). --āsun -- m.inf. such dexterity, etc., to be achieved or to exist. --thawun -- m.inf. to give dexterity, to teach a person to be dexterous, etc., as ab.
m. recognition, experience, discernment. --gaʦhun -- m. recognition to exist, to be generally recognized.
(for 1, see p. 750b, l. 48) m. assaying, testing (a precious metal or the like).

conj. 1 (1 p.p. parkhôwᵘ), to test, assay (a precious metal); to cause to be inspected, to have or get (a thing) tested, tried, proved (K. 953). parkhôwᵘ-motᵘ perf. part. (f. parkhövᵘ̈-müʦᵘ̈), tested, assayed.
f. test, assay, examining, examination by comparison with a standard.
m. a long tear or rent (in cloth, the skin, or the like). parkölⁱ wasȧnⁱ m. pl.inf. tears to descend, i.e. to be rent from top to bottom and all round.

m. measure, capacity, weight, length, extent; a weight (for weighing) (cf. gāḍa-pᵒ, p. 276b, l. 22; khȧrⁱ-pⁱ, p. 411a, l. 10) (El. parmān, K.Pr. 234); cf. parimān. -wörᵘ̈ f. a pile of weights; a dish or bowl for holding weights.

m. (sg. dat. parmānʦhanas), the ceremony of the second entrance, i.e. of the first visit after marriage, or else the visit previous to cohabitation, of a newly-married couple to the bride's father's house (Śiv. 56, paramāʦhun; K.Pr. 167). According to El. (paramántsun) this word means 'the third day after marriage'. See L. 269 ff. ¶ parmānʦhan-bôgᵘ m. the present given to the bridegroom by the bride's parents, etc., on the occasion of this festival. -ḍuḍa m. an uninvited guest who sponges at the feast of this festival at the house of the bride's father. -mahārĕñ f. the bride on this occasion. -mahārāza m. the bridegroom on this occasion.

m. (sg. dat. parmūzanas), wiping off; esp. after making offerings to gods or demigods on certain Hindū festivals, the emptying of the remains in the vessels that had contained the offerings over the roots of some plants, on to a river bank, or other suitable place (cf. ḍulᵘ-pᵘ, p. 212b, l. 6).

or pārudᵘ m. (sg. dat. pāradas or pāradis), mercury, quicksilver (El. párádú, párúd) (Śiv. 1555, K.Pr. 165). ¶ pārad-kān or pārȧdⁱ-kān f. a quicksilver mine. ¶ pāradyukᵘ gen. (f. pāradicᵘ̈), of, or belonging to, quicksilver; coated with, or amalgamated with, quicksilver.
f. N. of Durgā, born as the daughter of the Himâlaya, having been Satī in a former birth (Śiv. 101, 111, 436, 486, 869, 1139; Rām. 1585).
adj. c.g. of, or belonging to, another, another's; other, another, strange, foreign, alien, extraneous.
m. (f. parpürᵘ̈), a prater, a chatterer, one who habitually and continually talks nonsense.
m. the condition of being, or becoming, full of holes (e.g. in a worn cloth, or worn-out vessel).

m. the amount of difference in weight between the contents of the two pans of a pair of scales, a make-weight (K.Pr. 63); an equipoise (K.Pr. 216); the filling up of a deficiency (in making gifts, eating, etc.). Cf. para.
m. the sound of a footstep, a footfall (H. xii, 15). Cf. par 3.

or pārthī-pūzā f. (among Hindūs) the worship of the Pārthiva-linga. These diminutive lingas are made of clay taken from the foot of the Taḵẖt hill. The usual number worshipped at one time are eleven, or 111, or 1,100. They are thrown into the river on the evening of the same day (see RT.Tr. ii, 128, note) (Śiv. 740, i.q. pārthiwa-pūzā, Śiv. 209).
in pārthiwa-pūzā, i.q. pārthī-pūzā, s.v. pārthī, q.v. (Śiv. 209).

adj. (f. parᵘ̈zᵘ̈ or parüzᵘ̈), different from oneself, alien, foreign, a stranger, foreigner, someone else, a person with whom one has no connexion (cf. pān-pᵒ, p. 735b, l. 3) (L.V. 92; Rām. 469, 687, 813, 1060, 1062; K.Pr. 43, 101, 165); of, or belonging to, or connected with, another (Gr.Gr. 153); an enemy (K.Pr. 166).

or (L.V. 18, 21) paḍun conj. 1 (1 p.p. porᵘ), to read out, repeat, recite (cf. nikāh pᵒ, p. 629b, l. 31; nā-sazā pᵒ, p. 659b, l. 8) (Gr.Gr. 106-7, 114-16, 178, 191, 197, 199; Gr.M.; Śiv. 11, 800-1, 1115-17, 1131, 1164, 1498-9, etc.; Rām. 1140; K. 485, 568, 666; K.Pr. 166) (parun warun, a jingle, to read and the like (Gr.Gr. 95); parun zānun, to know how to read (Gr.Gr. 187)); to read (to oneself), peruse (Rām. 842, 854; K. 644, 955; H. xii, 18, 23); to mutter a spell, etc.) (Śiv. 211, 1760; Rām. 1298); to recite (praise, pious words, entreaty, abuse, etc.) (cf. phāsh parȧnⁱ, p. 712b, l. 20) (L.V. 18, 21; Śiv. 27, 163, 209, 354, 356, 378, etc.; Rām. 182, 214, 259, 367, 964-5, 1455, etc.; K. 1038-9; H. vi, 17; vii, 4; xii, 1; YZ. 111, 121, 175, 262); to learn, study (L.V. 36; Śiv. 59, 248, 707, 758, 1171; Rām. 101, 993; K. 487, 1082; H. viii, 3, 4; K.Pr. 174); to make out, decipher. ¶ porᵘ-motᵘ perf. part. (f. pürᵘ̈-müʦᵘ̈), (of a book or the like) read, studied; one who has studied, i.e. who has finished his studies and has completed his education, well-read (K.Pr. 173); one who has mastered some particular branch of knowledge. ¶ paran-bāgi adv. for the sake of learning, for learning (e.g. a teacher's fee). -bāna m. the good fortune of study, the excellent results of education. -grākh n.ag. (sg. dat. -grākas; f. -grākañ), a reader, one who reads (Gr.Gr. 106); i.q. the next. - wôlᵘ n.ag. (f. -wājĕñ), a reader, a student (W. 112); one who has studied, an expert (on learning), esp. an expert in charms for curing diseases, expelling demons, or the like (Gr.Gr. 106). -vizᵘ̈ f. the time of study, school-hours. ¶ paranay neg. conj. part., not having read (Gr.Gr. 111).

conj. 1 (1 p.p. pôrᵘ), to tie the (already combed) hair, to plait or otherwise arrange the hair (cf. mas pᵒ, p. 595b, l. 30) (Gr.M.; L. 459, to comb; YZ. 223). pörᵘ̈-müʦᵘ̈ f. perf. part. (a woman) whose hair is plaited or otherwise done up.

conj. 1 (1 p.p. pôrᵘ), to finish, accomplish, complete (El., Gr.M., Śiv. 1915); to arrange, make completely ready (H. iii, 7, a bed; YZ. 29, 267); esp. to finish or complete a fast (cf. dāran pᵒ, p. 247a, l. 4, and pāran).
conj. 1 (1 p.p. pôrᵘ), to throw dice or a coin (e.g. for an omen, to decide a question, or in gambling, to toss for an innings or the like).

adv. last year (El. also parur) (Gr.Gr. 158, W. 95). [Authorities differ as to the meaning of this word. I.K. (iv, 119, 151) translates it by parāri, 'the year before last.'] -kani adv. about last year. ¶ parsukᵘ adj. (f. parsucᵘ̈), of, or belonging to, or produced in, last year.
or parwāh m. care, concern, anxiety, vexation (El.); fear, terror (Śiv. 777 ˚wā, 1302 ˚wāh). Cf. bē-parwā and parwāy.
m. a warrant, sanction (in writing), order, pass, passport.
adj. c.g. a cherisher as in nafs-parwar, a cherisher of self, a selfish person (K.Pr. 150).
adj. e.g. used at end of compounds, fostered, nourished, cherished, bred, reared, brought up (cf. nāz-parward, Rām. 609, p. 675a, l. 37).
m. the Cherisher, the Provider, Providence, an epithet of the Deity (H. i, 11).
f. cherishing, as in hunar-parwarī, cherishing of art, fondness for art (K.Pr. 150).
m. care, anxiety, fear, terror (Rām. 104, 208, 484, 576, 578, 844, 1049, 1276, 1488; K. 521); inclination, desire, affection, i.q. parwā, q.v.
? f. flying, flight. parwāz tul, take wings and fly! (L. 99, K.Pr. 46).
m. (sg. dat. paryö̃kas), a bed, a couch (L.V. 73). Cf. prang.

m. a sieve, sifter, strainer, riddle. According to El. such is made of a broad wooden hoop with a bottom of perforated sheepskin (L. 464, párun, Śiv. 1527, K.Pr. 166). ¶ parinⁱ chān f. (but chān 2 is m.), sifting in a sieve. --chöñᵘ̈ -- f., id. --chöñᵘ̈lagüñᵘ̈ -- f.inf. sieve-sifting to begin; met. a light shower (quasi, water sent down through a sieve) to begin. -ʦar m. the being covered with small holes (like a sieve), the being worm-eaten or similarly damaged. ¶ parininⁱ zȧdⁱ gaʦhȧnⁱ m. pl. inf. to become the holes of a sieve; met. (of a person beaten) to have the whole body covered with holes or wounds.

conj. 1 (1 p.p. parzanôwᵘ), i.q. prazanun, q.v. to recognize (Rām. 394, 426, 1254, 1467; H. viii, 9, 10; x, 5, 12; xii, 2); to recognize, understand, grasp the meaning of (Gr.M.; Śiv. 350, 522, 958, 1065, 1175, 1193, etc.). parzanāwana yunᵘ m.inf. pass., i.q. prazanana yunᵘ, q.v., s.v. prazanun. parzanôwᵘ-motᵘ perf. part. (f. parzanövᵘ̈-müʦᵘ̈), i.q. prazonᵘ-motᵘ, q.v., s.v. id. parzanāwan-wôlᵘ n.ag. (f. -wājĕñ), one who is skilled in recognizing or testing, an expert.
f. the condition of a personal servant.
f. service as a personal attendant.

conj. 1 (1 p.p. parzonᵘ; 2 p.p. parzañōv), to recognize, etc., i.q. prazanun (K. 459, 583, 595; YZ. 434). parzonᵘ-motᵘ perf. part. (f. parzüñᵘ̈-müʦᵘ̈), recognized, etc., i.q. prazonᵘ-motᵘ, s.v. prazanun, q.v.
conj. 1 (1 p.p. parzônᵘ; 2 p.p. parzāñōv), to recognize (L.V. 7, 14, 46); i.q. prazanun, q.v.

m. (sg. dat. parzanas), a servant, a personal attendant, retainer (Skt. parijana) (El.; K.Pr. 2, 104). parzan-bāpār m. the duties of a personal servant. -bāy f. the wife of a personal servant. -kār m. the occupation of a personal servant. -küṭᵘ̈ f. (sg. dat. -kacĕ), his daughter, esp. the daughter of a good servant. -kaṭh m. (sg. dat. -kaṭas), his son, esp. the son of a good servant. -pônᵘ m. the occupation of a personal servant. -wôlᵘ m. (f. -wājĕñ), a man who has several personal servants (indicating his wealth).
m. (sg. dat. parzanas), recognition (cf. parzanun, prazanun). parzan (or parzanas, K. 397) yunᵘ , m.inf. to come to recognition, to recognize (K. 397, 458).
m. (sg. dat. parʦanas), recognition (L.V. 58), i.q. pörⁱzān, q.v.
m. (sg. dat. -pȧnḍitas), a semi-learned man, a man who is not deeply learned, but who has a great reputation for learning, or who, in his own immediate circle, is looked upon as learned.
adv. after, behind; at length, in fine, finally; then, therefore, thence (W. 100).

m. (sg. abl. pāsa 1), watching, guarding; observance, consideration, attention to, regard, respect, sake, sense, deference (Śiv. 592, 1315, 1467, 1670, 1745). According to El. it is used with names of God, meaning 'for the sake of'; so W. 97, pāsa, Śiv. 1257. --bōzun -- m.inf. to show respect (to), to treat with honour. --gaʦhun -- m.inf. respect to occur, respect to be achieved. --karun -- m.inf. to make respect, to cause a man to behave decently; to treat a person politely, to grant politely (Rām. 161). --pyonᵘ -- m.inf. compassion to be shown (to a poor man in difficulties); politeness or patience to be shown (on the intercession of some honourable person). --wuchun -- m.inf. to bear patiently (another's fault). ¶ pāsa-wôlᵘ m. (f. -wājĕñ), one who has many respectful adherents.

i.q. pāsa 2, in ās-pās, p. 51a, l. 26 (Śiv. 1441). --karun -- m.inf. to do side, to make side (upon, pĕṭh, a person), i.e. to protect (a person) (Rām. 538, 1038, 1184); (in a dispute) to take sides, to show partiality.
m. a side, direction (cf. potᵘ pᵒ, s.v. potᵘ); the back or reverse of a paper or the like; the page of a book (Gr.M.).
m. a die, dice (oblong in shape and rolled out of the hand in playing).
i.q. pās 1, q.v. in hissa-pāsa, p. 354b, l. 1.
m. the after-juice, the second juice expressed by the addition of water to the article from which the full juice has already been expressed.

adj. c.g. approved, preferable, choice (Gr.M.); approving, choosing (in this sense chiefly --˚; cf. khŏd-pasandī, p. 392a, l. 11); fond of, as in mŏrda-pᵒ, fond of the dead, i.e. speaking well of a deceased person (de mortuis, etc.) (K.Pr. 16); cf. prasand. --gaʦhun -- m.inf. to be approved, chosen, to be pleasing. --karun -- m.inf. to approve of (Gr.M.; H. v, 1; xii, 4). --yunᵘ -- m.inf. to meet the approval (of), be chosen, be selected, to please, to suit (a person, dat.) (Gr.M.). --lagun -- m.inf. to meet with approval.
m. rest (El.). pasārapyonᵘ m.inf. to become poverty stricken, to lose all one's possessions and power.
conj. 1 (1 p.p. pasôrᵘ), i.q. pạsᵃrun, q.v. pasôrᵘ-motᵘ perf. part. (f. pasörᵘ̈-müʦᵘ̈), i.q. pạsᵒrᵒ-motᵒ, s.v. pạsᵃrun, q.v.
f. the duty of a guard, guard, watch (K.Pr. 161).
m. (f. pāsdārĕñ), a watchman, guard, sentinel; (in Kāshmīrī) one who is treated with respect, one whose opinion is deferred to (cf. pās 1).

m. a thatch, roof (of a house or boat), shingle, mat cover (of a boat) (cf. burza-pᵒ, p. 130b, l. 49; nar-pᵒ, p. 646a, l. 46; nāṭa-pᵒ, p. 660b, l. 15; nāwa-pᵒ, p. 666b, l. 16; potᵘ pᵒ, s.v. potᵘ; pĕʦi-pᵒ, s.v. pë̆ʦᵘ̈) (El.; Gr.M.; L. 463, pash; 464, pachi (?); Śiv. 784, 1245; K.Pr. 156, 167). It is generally made with an under layer of burza-bark, over which is laid the thatching-grass. --dyunᵘ -- m.inf. to thatch (a roof or the like). ¶ pashĕ-ganḍ hyonᵘ m.inf. to tie a thatch. -gāsa m. thatching-grass (generally laid over a layer of burza- bark). -gav adj. c.g. that of which the roof is gone, (a house) with a decayed roof. -horᵘ m. the pair of mats used as a thatch for a boat. -kūṭᵘ m. the beam on which a thatch is supported. --pĕṭhⁱ shīn trāwun -- m.inf. to shift the snow from the thatch; met. to accomplish something in a hurry, and in any order. wọ̆bᵘ m. an aperture in a thatch (for the admission of air, light, etc.). ¶ pashukᵘ gen. (f. pashë̆cᵘ̈), of, or belonging to, a thatch (K.Pr. 2). ¶ pashĕs khasun m.inf. to climb on to the roof (of a house); met. to become filled with haughtiness, to assume a lofty bearing.
m. a noose, halter; a hangman's noose; a gin, net (L.V. 6); --˚ (after a word signifying 'hair') a mass (of hair), a braid.
m. a burden (esp. a heavy one) as carried on a man's back or shoulders. --anun -- m.inf. to fasten a burden on to the back (usually tied on by a cloak or sheet).
m. a heretic, an infidel, in pāshã̄ḍ- hyuhᵘ adj. (f. -hishᵘ̈), one like a heretic; hence, a hideous, corpulent fellow.
m. (sg. dat. pashcātāpas), repentance, contrition, regret. Cf. pashĕtāwun.

adj. (f. pashcimᵘ̈), behind, hindmost; west, western (Śiv. 1412); to the west of (a certain place); cf. pashcim. --kun -- adv. to the west, towards the west, westwards. ¶ pashcimⁱ-kinⁱ adv. behind, after; from behind. ¶ pashcimi-kani adv. from behind. -kanyukᵘ adj. (f. -kanicᵘ̈), western, of, or belonging to, the west. ¶ pashcimyukᵘ adj. (f. pashcimicᵘ̈), of, or belonging to, the west.

in pashĕ-pashĕ m. habitual melancholy, hypochondriasis; cf. pashun 1. -pashĕ lagun m.inf. habitual melancholy to be incurred, (even when one is well off) to keep in bad spirits (as if one was poverty-stricken).

f.pl. minute examination and criticism, careful examination of the pros. and cons. of anything (cf. lᵃshĕ-pāshĕ, p. 533b, l. 5; raga- pᵒ, s.v. rag). --kaḍañĕ -- f. pl. inf. (in discussing the suitability of anything, e.g. a proposed marriage) carefully to examine and criticize the pros. and cons. (cf. lᵃshĕ pāshĕ kaḍañĕ, p. 533b, l. 7; raga-pāshĕ kaḍañĕ, s.v. rag); to break (something) into small pieces (Śiv. 253).
or (wom.) pēshēmān (K.Pr. 214) adj. c.g. penitent, sorry, remorseful, contrite (Rām. 1460; K.Pr. 13, 214). --sapadun -- m.inf. to repent (El.).
n.ag. (pashĕnāwavüñᵘ̈), one who causes another to lament (e.g. by reminding him or her of past sorrow).

conj. 1 (1 p.p. pashĕnôwᵘ), to cause to grieve, to cause to bewail, to cause to regret, to disappoint (e.g. a child who longs for some dainty) (K. 365). pashĕnôwᵘ-motᵘ perf. part. (f. pashĕnövᵘ̈-müʦᵘ̈), disappointed, etc., as ab.
m. (sg. dat. pashĕtāwanas), repentance, regret, rue, grief. Cf. pashcātāph.
f. a fee paid for seeing, in mŏkha-pᵒ, p. 560a, l. 19. Cf. pashun 3.
conj. 1 (1 p.p. pashowᵘ), i.q. pashun 2, q.v. pashowᵘ-motᵘ perf. part. (f. pashüvᵘ̈-müʦᵘ̈), planed smooth.

n.ag. (f. pashĕvüñᵘ̈), one who is easily cast down, one who is ready to lament over his own misfortunes; one who is ready to lament over another's misfortunes, one who is compassionate and sympathetic. Cf. pashun 1.
m. shawl-wool (mostly imported from Ladakh, and exported in large quantities to India) (El.).

m. a fine soft kind of woollen cloth. The wool is brought from Tibet and manufactured in Kashmīr (K.Pr. 167); cf. puy 1. -sondᵘ adj. (f. -sünzᵘ̈), (of a garment, etc.) made of this cloth. ¶ pashmīnukᵘ gen. (f. pashmīnücᵘ̈), of, or belonging to, this cloth (e.g. a price connected with it, or the cost of making it).
f.pl. the muscles of a joint; the ribs. -horᵘ m. the pair of sets of ribs (right and left), the two sides of the body of a man or beast.

conj. 1 (1 p.p. pashpôwᵘ), to cause to ooze, to cause to exude, to filter (a liquid), to drain out the dregs (K.Pr. 87). pashpôwᵘ-motᵘ perf. part. (pashpövᵘ̈-müʦᵘ̈), (of dregs) oozed out, (the last few drops) strained out, filtered out; (of a vessel containing liquid to be filtered or the like) emptied out by oozing or gradual leaking.
n.ag. (f. pashpavüñᵘ̈), that which oozes out, exuding, leaking out.
f. the act of dropping or oozing (cf. rūda-pᵒ, s.v. rūd).

conj. 2 (1 p.p. poshpᵘ. According to Īśvara-kaula, see Gr.Gr. xlv, this verb is of the 3rd conj. with 2 p.p. pashpyōv), to ooze out, drip, exude, perspire (cf. lānath pashpüñᵘ̈, p. 528a, l. 9) (Gr.M., Rām. 1178). ¶ poshpᵘ-motᵘ perf. part. (f. püshpᵘ̈-müʦᵘ̈), oozed out, exuded. ¶ pashpan-bāna m. an ooze-vessel, a filter; the vessel in which filtered liquid is collected. -wôñᵘ m. water of oozing, dropping water, exuding water.
m. the Skt. form of poshᵘ, q.v., esp. a brute, a beast, a person who is not initiated into the mysteries of the Śaiva religion.

conj. 1 (1 p.p. poshᵘ), to grieve (about), to bewail, regret (Gr.M.; Śiv. 1255; Rām. 1484, 1610, 1696; K.Pr. 156); to be sorry (L. 464, Rām. 1708); to be filled with regret, to be miserable (Rām. 825). pashĕn-bāna m. a vessel of regrets, one who is full of regrets at the sight of another's misfortune; one who is ever a cause of regret, one who habitually is a source of sorrow.
conj. 1 (1 p.p. poshᵘ), to shave or plane (wood, with a plane, adze, or the like); cf. pashĕwun. --dyunᵘ -- m.inf. to plane smooth.
conj. 1, to see (L.V. 20, 59); conj. 3, to be seen, to be recognized (as so-and-so) (L.V. 16). This is an old word, noted only in L.V.
m. in pashṭa-woturᵘ m. the page of an almanac containing the tables which show the motions of the planets.
f. animalness, conduct (on the part of a man) like that of an animal.
f. the business of a petty shopkeeper, of a druggist, of a grocer.

m. a mean petty shopkeeper, a druggist, a grocer (cf. Hindī pansārī), in the following:--pasörⁱ-bāy f. the wife of such a petty shopkeeper. -küṭᵘ̈ f. the daughter of such a petty shopkeeper; (as an abusive term) an ill-conducted woman. -kaṭh m. (sg. dat. -kaṭas), the son of such a petty shopkeeper; (as an abusive term) a mean, ill-conducted man. -pöthᵃr m. the occupation of a mean petty shopkeeper; occupation (of some one else) similar to such. -wān m. the shop of such a mean shopkeeper.

or pasth adj. c.g. low, depressed; low, humble; abject, mean, base, vile; (in Kāshmīrī) reduced to destitution (e.g. a country or a great person), wasted away (from disease). --gaʦhun -- m.inf. to become reduced to destitution (as ab.); to become humiliated (Rām. 925); to become utterly wasted away from sickness, to be reduced to a shadow.

f. lowness, inferiority; humility; baseness; (in Kāshmīrī) the being brought to misery (e.g. of a rich person reduced to destitution, or of a sick person reduced to a shadow). --anüñᵘ̈ -- f.inf. (with reference to some great person) destitution to take place. --yiñᵘ̈ -- f.inf., id.
f. a tax, octroi-duty. pastari-bal m. an octroi-post, a custom-house.

m. (sg. dat. pāsakas), a guardian, a tutelary, deity, a deified serpent who guards hidden treasure. pāsȧkⁱ-dar m. (f. -dariñ), a watchful secret guardian of something hidden (quasi, one who acts like a guardian serpent, as ab.).
m. humility, abjectness, destitution, want of necessaries. Cf. past.
f. (sg. dat. pạsᵃrüñᵃ), paring off the edges of a metal plate (for manufacture); beating out a metal plate to flatten it or beat it thin.

conj. 1 (1 p.p. pạsᵒrᵒ), to pare off the edges of a metal plate (in manufacture); to beat out a metal plate to flatten it or beat it thin. pạsᵒrᵒ-motᵒ perf. part. (f. pạsᵘ̈rᵘ̈-müʦᵘ̈), having the edges pared off; beaten out flat.
f. a chip, filing or the like (such as cutting from the edge of a metal plate in making a vessel). Cf. pạsᵃrun.
(? spelling and gend.) Datisca cannabina, used to make a yellow dye (L. 68, where it is also called waft tanj).

m. a slab, tablet, plate (of metal, for inscription or engraving of royal edicts, grants, etc.); a deed, a title-deed (of land), a deed of lease; a superficies, the width (of a board, piece of cloth, or the like); ˚-- a chair, a throne; a tiara, a diadem; i.q. paṭh in all its senses. -boḍᵘ adj. (f. -büdᵘ̈), of great width, very wide. -holᵘ adj. (f. -hüjᵘ̈), (of something flat) having a crooked, or uneven, width. paṭa-rönī  f. a queen (decorated with a tiara), the principal wife of a king (K. 730, 1132). ¶ paṭukᵘ adj. (f. paṭücᵘ̈), of, or belonging to, a title-deed; of, or belonging to, width. See also paṭh.

m. a sign, mark, token, clue, hint; address, direction (of a place to which, e.g., a person or letter, is directed); cf. pay 2. --anun 1 -- (for 2, see path 3) m.inf. to recognize a clue, remark a clue. --kaḍun -- m.inf. to search for a clue, etc. --thawun -- m.inf. to fix a clue, to establish a clue, come upon a clue after thorough search.
adj. c.g. containing width, wide in comparison with length.
m. (sg. dat. paṭākas), a kind of straight two-edged sword. Cf. paṭökⁱ, paṭösⁱ, and pŏṭösⁱ.
m. a sinner, a person who habitually commits sins.
m. a chapter, or section, of a book.

m. hell (in Hinduism), the name of the lowest of the seven hells (Śiv. 246, 704, 856, 985, 1214, 1254, 1412, 1664; Rām. 21, 516, 562, 606, 924, 1009, 1106, 1716, 1725; K. 632). ¶ pātölⁱ-kônⁱ adj. (f. -köñᵘ̈), one who squints downwards, i.e. the pupils of whose eyes are always turned downwards when they should be horizontal. ¶ pātālukᵘ sg. gen. (f. pātālücᵘ̈), of, or belonging to, hell, hellish, hell-begotten.
m. a quarter of a town, esp. one which has lately become inhabited; N. of an important village about fourteen miles north-west of Śrīnagar.
m. a moth (El.); a bird; a paper kite (Gr.M.). --trāwun -- m.inf. to fly a kite.
adj. c.g. swift as a bird, swift going, swift, speedy.
m. onomat. the noise of something falling from a height into mud or water, splash, flop. Cf. pŏṭās.

or pātashĕh (= پادشاہ, بادشہ) m. (the same as pādshāh, q.v.), a king (pātashāh, H. ii, 8, 10, 11; iii, 1-8; v, 7, 9, 11, etc.; pātashĕh, H. ii, 5, 8, 9; xii, 5, 10-14, etc.). -bāy f. a king's wife, a queen (H. viii, 1-4, 6, 11-13). -kūrᵘ̈ or -kūḍᵘ̈ f. a king's daughter, a princess (H. v, 2, 5, 8-10; xii, 1, 2). -zāda m. a king's son, a prince (H. viii, 3-5, 11). ¶ pātashĕham = پادشاھم interj. my king! your majesty! (H. ii, 4; v. 9; viii, 2, 6-8, 10, 13; x, 2, 6, 12; xii, 3, 19, 23).

f. (the same as pādshöhī and pāthᵃshöhī, qq.v.), royalty, sovereignty, the state or condition of a king (H. x, 2, 4, 9); a kingdom (H. x, 11; xii, 19). --karüñᵘ̈ -- f.inf. to exercise sovereignty, rule (H. viii, 12; x, 4; xii, 26).

patav, or patō adv. in the end, finally, at last (Rām. 414, 879, 1314); in the end, after all, in reality (Rām. 1538, 1732); cf. potᵘ and path 3. --lākan -- or --lökin -- adv. 'at the last load (lākh)'; hence, at last, finally (Gr.M.; W. 95; Śiv. 878; Rām. 26, 517, 879, 925, 1459, 1476, 1729). Cf. potᵘ-lākh, p. 786b, l. 30.
m. running away secretly, absconding, decamping.
conj. 1 (1 p.p. paṭôwᵘ), to run away secretly, abscond, decamp (this verb is treated as transitive).
n.ag. (f. paṭavüñᵘ̈), that which can be achieved, feasible, easy.

m. (sg. dat. paṭas), a long strip of cloth as it comes from the loom, cloth in the piece; a plank (El. paṭ); the board on which wool is spread to have a paste of rice and water rubbed into it (El. paṭ); the board or plank on which the dead body of a Hindū is placed and carried away to the place of cremation (El. paṭh); a pavement, the floor of a flagged area (L.V. 52); i.q. paṭa in all its senses. --chalun -- m.inf. to wash the cloth; met. suddenly to give up one's business (e.g. from loss of fortune, implements, etc.). --chalith bĕhun -- m.inf., id. ¶ paṭa-sᵃthᵃr m. (sg. dat. -sᵃtras), stout thread (for weaving coarse cloth). -sᵃtra-kônᵃ m. a ball of this thread. ¶ paṭukᵘ sg. gen. (f. paṭücᵘ̈), of, or belonging to, cloth; see also paṭa.

m. (sg. dat. pathas), a certain measure of land, a piece of land of such a size that it needs one trakh (or about nine and a half lb.) of seed grain to sow it (cf. dã̄-path, p. 230b, l. 36). --˚ a level piece of land generally (cf. bumi-pᵒ, p. 107b, l. 33; in āra-path, p. 41a, l. 46, the word is f.). --˚ something flat (cf. dāñĕwali-pᵒ, p. 232a, l. 8; kan-path, p. 447b, l. 13). ¶ patha-waturᵘ m. a memorandum showing the area (measured path by path) which has been sown.

m. (sg. dat. pātas), alighting, descending; a shedding, discharge, granting in full (Śiv. 1036, 1492, 1535, 1553, 1556, 1748, 1798, always in the compound shĕkti-pāth, a shedding of power, i.e. a miraculous and gracious favour. Cf. pacha-pᵒ, p. 679a, l. 23).

m. (sg. dat. pāṭas), reciting, recitation, repeating (cf. öhī-pᵒ, p. 17b, l. 10; bata-pᵒ, p. 137a, l. 46; rᵃʦar-pᵃ, s.v. rᵃʦar) (K.Pr. 182); reading, perusal, study; studying or reciting the Vēdas, etc., worship (El. pãṭ) (K. 484). --karun -- m.inf. to read, study; to repeat or revise a lesson; to recite or repeat charms or daily portions of the Vēdas, etc. -pūzā f. the performance of Vedic repetitions, worship, and other pious acts. ¶ pāṭa-wôlᵘ m. (f. -wājĕñ), one who habitually recites charms, Vedic passages, or the like. ¶ pāṭas bĕhun m.inf. to sit for a recitation, i.e. to carry out with due formality a recitation of the Vēdas, etc.
f. a path, a way, in amara-pathi, on the path (leading to) immortality (L.V. 70).
f. (sg. dat. pöʦᵘ̈), used --˚ a dish, a vessel (cf. gahᵃna-pᵃ, p. 281a, l. 10).
m. in papan-pāṭh, p. 719b, l. 18. Cf. pöṭhⁱ.

adv. and postpos. governing abl., behind, after (cf. dŏha-path dŏha, day after day, day by day, p. 200a, l. 22; nāwa-path nāwa, name by name, p. 665b, l. 38; pŏtus path, s.v. pŏtus (L. 458 pat, W. 97); after, in honour of, for the sake of (Śiv. 1421, 1685; Rām. 192, 1059, 1507, 1510, 1662); (apparently governing dat.) H. vii, 10, path wanan, back in the forests, deep in the forests; (as adv.) afterwards (Rām. 562, 1655); cf. patau and potᵘ. --aʦun -- m.inf. to come back, turn back, return (esp. from some work which has been given up as hopeless), desist; cf. --ʦā-motᵘ, bel. --brō̃ṭh -- adv. backwards and forwards (cf. path brō̃ṭh nērun, p. 128a, l. 32) (Śiv. 1790); behind and before, in all directions (Śiv. 1776); cf. pata- brō̃ṭh, bel. --gaʦhun -- m.inf. to go backwards, retreat (Rām. 1081, 1643). --hyonᵘ -- m.inf. to take the back, retire into the background, to cease to have effect (Śiv. 1237, 1843); to be defeated, to be surpassed (Śiv. 1246). --koḍᵘ-motᵘ -- perf. part. (f. --küḍᵘ̈-müʦᵘ̈ --), repelled, driven back; caused to desist (from any work). --kaḍun -- m.inf. to turn (a person) back, repel, drive back; to cause a person to desist (from any work). -khŏr or -khōr m. 'a step back', falling from riches into poverty, reduction to indigence. -khŏr gaʦhun or -khōrgaʦhun m.inf. indigence (after wealth) to befall. -kāli adv. in the time behind, i.e. very long ago, in ancient days, in olden time (L.V. 91, K. 240). -kāli-pĕṭha adv. from ancient times (Śiv. 1653). -kölⁱ adv. in ancient days, in olden time; from ancient days, from olden time. -kālyukᵘ adj. (f. kālicᵘ̈), of, or belonging to, olden time. ¶ path-kun adv. or postpos. governing the dat. or abl., behind, at the back of (cf. atha path-kun gaʦhun, p. 61b, l. 22, and --thawun, p. 61b, l. 27) (K.Pr. 44); after (of time or place) (cf. ami path-kun, p. 55a, l. 4, or awa path-kun, p. 55b, l. 43, thereafter, thereupon) (Śiv. 70, 311); backwards (El.); in former times, formerly (Śiv. 72, 425, 1908; Rām. 230, 472; K. 347); in the rear, at the back; afterwards, at the end, finally (Śiv. 1344, 1901; H. iii, 5; v, 5, 8); behind, left behind, left over and above, remaining (Śiv. 38, 1194); backwards, in the reversed position (Rām. 634, 1168). ¶ path korᵘ-motᵘ perf. part. (f. --kürᵘ̈-müʦᵘ̈ --), left behind, left over, left remaining; left behind (by others who have gone on ahead); put back, defeated, conquered. --karun -- m.inf. to leave (something) over and above (in a distribution or the like); (to go ahead and) leave (some one) behind (Rām. 461); to put back, defeat, conquer. --lagun -- m.inf. to follow, to pursue; to follow, to seek for earnestly (Śiv. 583); to be earnestly engaged in (dat.) (K. 67). --pahān -- adv. a little behind, a little after (of place or time) (Gr.Gr. 94). --phērun -- m.inf. to turn back, return (Śiv. 1836, Rām. 207); to turn back, retreat (Rām. 1345). --pushᵉ̆rāwun -- m.inf. to entrust to (with dat.), make over to (Rām. 181, cf. 664). --path thawun -- m.inf. to keep putting behind oneself, i.e. to abstract and keep secretly for oneself, bit by bit, the whole, or part, of some collected property, to pilfer in this way. --raṭun -- m.inf. to hold (a person back), restrain (K. 140, 141, 1056). --rōzun -- m.inf. to remain behind, to be behind, stay behind, wait (K. 261); to come in last (in a procession or the like) (Rām. 13); to refrain (from a course of conduct) (K. 1057); to remain over and above (H. xii, 23); to stand back (El. pat roz, impve.), to remain, endure, continue after (Rām. 28). --thawun -- or --thāwun -- m.inf. to put back, keep in reserve; to put back, repel (Śiv. 861). --trāwun -- m.inf. to leave behind, abandon; to abandon thoughts of, to forgive, treat as not having occurred (Śiv. 425). --ʦalun -- m.inf. to run back, retreat, flee from some one's presence (Rām. 1342). --ʦāmotᵘ -- perf. part. (f. --ʦāmüʦᵘ̈ --), come back, returned (after giving up some difficult task or the like), having desisted (from); cf. --aʦun, ab. --ʦānun -- m.inf. to cause a person to turn back or desist (from something). --ʦônᵘ-motᵘ -- perf. part. (f. --ʦöñᵘ̈-müʦᵘ̈ --), one who has been caused to desist, as ab. ¶ pata 2 (for 1, see s.v.) adv. and postpos. (governing the abl. or, in the case of an, masc. nouns in the singular, and occasionally in the case of pronouns, the dat.), behind, after (in place) (cf. arwa-pᵒ, p. 45b, l. 39; pyāda pata lagun, s.v. pyāda) (Śiv. 80, 440, 724, 759; Rām. 1038, 1699, 1760; K.Pr. 26); after (in point of time) (ami-pᵒ, p. 55a, l. 3; H. viii, 13; xii, 11; amiy-pᵒ, p. 55b, l. 3; ath-pᵒ, p. 55b, l. 22; awa-pᵒ, p. 55b, l. 41; khā̃dara-pᵒ, p. 393b, l. 18; shāma-pᵒ, after evening, El.) (Gr.Gr. 159; Gr.M.; Śiv. 131, 327, 1792; Rām. 633, 637, 876-7; K. 135-6, 190, 211, 233, 256, 281, etc.; H. x, 12; xii, 16); tath- pata (for tawa-pᵒ), after that, thereafter (K. 377); so tas-pata, after that (K. 627 = tawa pata, K. 628); after, with reference to (Śiv. 622); after, following after (Śiv. 1436; Rām. 757; K. 5, 1031, 1035; H. (dat.) ii, 9; vi, 8; xi, 18; xii, 1, 7); after, following at one's heels, close to (Śiv. 1584, 1804); as adv., afterwards (K. 587, 623, 689; H. viii, 7; xi, 18; xii, 6, 10, 25; K.Pr. 167; sometimes used distributively as in gara-pᵒ, in every house (p. 295b, l. 2; K.Pr. 29) (cf. prath). --anun 2 -- (for 1, see pata 1) m.inf. to repeat, go over (a lesson or the like previously learnt). ¶ pata-boḍᵘ adj. (f. -büḍᵘ̈), one who, or that which, from former or ancestral times has been and still is great (in status, reputation, prosperity, or the like). -bajĕr m. hereditary or continued greatness, etc., as ab. --brō̃ṭh -- adv. from back to front; cf. path-brō̃ṭh, ab. --brō̃ṭh wuchun -- m.inf. to look at from back to front; hence, to gaze over with extreme affection. --brō̃ṭha -- adv. behind and before (K. 1007). --brō̃ṭhas wuchun -- m.inf. to look backwards and forwards, to look behind and before (K. 149). ¶ pata-ḍakha m. a back-prop, i.e. support, help. --dōrun -- m.inf. to run after, pursue. --dōranāwun -- m.inf. to cause to run after, to set in pursuit (Śiv. 1479). -gath adj. c.g. going behind, following; a follower, one who obeys, one who is devoted to, obedient, faithful (to). ¶ pata gaʦhun m.inf. to follow (Rām. 927, 930; K. 693); to follow, to go subsequently to, to go (to summon a person, dat.) (K. 690); to be devoted (to), obedient (to), faithful (to) (Śiv. 1623); to go behind (a person, dat.) (Rām. 1416). ¶ pata-kani adv. behind, in the rear (Śiv. 1734, K. 985); prep. governing dat. behind (El. darwázas patah kanyi, behind the door; W. 97, pathkani; K. 609). -kanĕn adv., id. -kanyukᵘ adj. (f. kanicᵘ̈), of, or belonging to, or produced in, the rear. ¶ pata lagun m.inf. to stick behind, i.e. to urge, impel vigorously; to come up close behind (a person, dat.), to follow closely (K. 417). -lār f. pursuing after, the occurrence of impediments even while in the act of accomplishing a work (Śiv. 1795). --lārun -- m.inf. to run after, pursue (Śiv. 307, 1395, 1466, 1606, 1626, 1684, 1753; Rām. 334, 375; K. 163, 262, 265, 285, 662, 884); pata pata lārun, to follow persistently, pursue (cf. pata pata, bel.) (Śiv. 7, 1364, 1439, 1894; K. 417, 596-7, 629). ¶ pata-phĕran m. a customary gift of clothes sent by her parents to a bride after she has gone to her husband's house. --pata -- adv. continually after (e.g. in following after a person), dogging so-and-so's footsteps (K.Pr. 56, 57; Śiv. 7, 479, 1364, 1382, 1439, 1894; Rām. 1316, 1486; K. 185, 218, 1128; H. iii, 1, 2; viii, 9; xii, 7; YZ. 109); cf. --lārun, ab. and --yunᵘ, bel. --pata nērun -- m.inf. to go out following (a person, dat.), to follow out behind (K. 934). ¶ pata rōzun m.inf. to keep behind a person, to remain behind (El.); to keep urging a person at work; to remain behind, to survive (L.V. 67). --sōzun -- m.inf. to send after (a person), to send (so-and-so) to (so-and-so) (Śiv. 639). --ṭhān karun -- m.inf. to cover, conceal, hide (some sin or disgrace). -thüzᵘ̈ thavüñᵘ̈ f.inf. to display pride, arrogance, haughtiness (whether entitled to do so or not). ¶ pata-wath adv. by the ancient way, conformably to rule or custom. -wathukᵘ adj. (f. -wathücᵘ̈), that which has come down from former times, according to old rule or custom. --wātun -- m.inf. to arrive behind, to come up to a person from behind, (in pursuit) to reach, overtake (the person pursued, dat.) (K. 599). ¶ pata yunᵘ m.inf. to follow after, to follow (a person, dat.) (K. 235, 265, 506, 649, 1125; K.Pr. 232); pata pata yunᵘ, to follow along after (dat.), to keep following (K. 270). -zīrᵘ̈ f. a push behind; urging, impelling, encouraging. ¶ patukᵘ adj. (f. patücᵘ̈), of, or belonging to, behind, of past times; of behind, of the rear of, immediately behind, immediately succeeding.
m. (f. paṭhöñᵘ̈), a Paṭhān, an Afghān (W. 17). In Kashmīr, the f. is also used in a special sense. paṭhöñᵘ̈ f. a female Paṭhān (W. 17, paṭhönⁱ); met. a bold woman (coarse in body and powerful).
conj. 1 (1 p.p. pāthanôwᵘ), to cause to come into existence (cf. pöʦhᵃrāwun) (Gr.Gr. 173).

adv. down, below, at the bottom, on the floor (u.w. vbs. of sitting, putting, or the like) (Gr.M., Rām. 925). --bĕhun -- m.inf. to sit down, to crouch down (Rām. 287, 432, 801). -kun adv. down, below, beneath (u.w. vbs. of looking at, putting, or the like). --pāwun -- m.inf. to throw down from a height to the bottom, to throw, or hurl, down to the ground (Śiv. 1626; H. iii, 9); to reduce to indigence, to overwhelm with misfortune. --pyōmotᵘ -- perf. part. (f. --pyēmüʦᵘ̈ --), fallen down, fallen from a height to the bottom; reduced to indigence, overwhelmed by misfortune. --pyonᵘ -- m.inf. to fall from a height to the bottom, to fall down (Rām. 713, 894, 926, 1176, 1385, 1411; H. ii, 11; YZ. 32, 377); to be reduced to indigence, to be overwhelmed by misfortune. --wasun -- m.inf. to descend to the ground (Rām. 1180); to fall to the ground (H. ii, 3); to dismount (from a horse or the like) (Śiv. 788).
m. a corruption of pādshāh, q.v., in compounds such as jōgi-pᵒ, p. 371b, l. 16.
see asĕ-ti pāṭhi, p. 95a, l. 14; hōran-pᵒ, p. 349b, l. 38. In each case it is 3 sg. fut. of a verb *pāṭhun, not elsewhere noted; but equivalent in meaning to pāthun, q.v.
f. royalty, sovereignty, sway, rule (cf. pādshöhī and pātashöhī). --karüñᵘ̈ -- f.inf. to rule (in or over), to reign (Rām. 1739).
m. (sg. dat. pāthalis), a low plain at the foot of a mountain, (El.) a valley. pāthalyukᵘ sg. gen. (f. pāthalicᵘ̈), of, or belonging to, such a plain.

conj. 3 (2 p.p. paṭhyōv), to be successfully completed, to end successfully, to turn out successfully (cf. myāda pᵒ, p. 613a, l. 38); (of some previously untrained child, horse, or the like) to become well trained by proper discipline (cf. atha pᵒ, p. 61b, l. 31). paṭhyō-motᵘ perf. part. (f. paṭhyē-müʦᵘ̈), successfully accomplished; well trained by undergoing appropriate discipline, well disciplined.

conj. 3 [2 p.p. pāthyōv. This verb employs the fut. in the sense of the pres., and the past cond. in the sense of the past ind. Thus pātha, I am; pāthahö, I was (Gr.Gr. 187). According to I.K. this verb is of the third conj. but a perf. part. pôthᵘ-motᵘ is reported; see bel. Its causal is pāthanāwun or rarely, pöʦhᵃrāwun (Gr.Gr. 173)] to be, to become, to come into existence (esp. when expected); cf. pāṭhi. pôthᵘ-motᵘ perf. part. (f. pöʦhᵘ̈-müʦᵘ̈), that which has come into existence (esp. as a by-product).

or pathurᵘ m. (sg. dat. patharas or patharis), a levelled area (such as the floor of a room, a courtyard of a house, or a levelled piece of ground near a house), bare ground (cf. dā̃-pᵒ, p. 230b, l. 43); the spreading or scattering here and there of things lying or thrown about on the ground (cf. pōshĕ-pᵒ, p. 779a, l. 12). ¶ pathȧrⁱ gaʦhun m.inf. to go on the level ground, i.e. to go by land (instead of by boat), to go afoot. --karȧnⁱ -- m. pl. inf. to make scatterings, to scatter about (e.g. to scatter hither and thither heaped up grain, and so to render it valueless). --wöñᵘ̈ -- adv. on, or all over, the floor or bare ground.
m. a village accountant, the official who keeps the village fiscal registers, a land steward (H. ix, 10). I.q. paṭwörī, q.v.

m. (sg. dat. pātras), a vessel, pot, dish (cf. pöthᵃr and pötᵃr); a fit or worthy person, a 'chosen vessel' (learned, well conducted, contented, merciful, courteous, and the like) (cf. prayĕma-pᵒ, p. 774a, l. 34).

or pạtᵃr 1 m. (sg. dat. pạtras. When the second member of a masculine compound, this word takes the form wạthᵃr, Gr.Gr. 74; but, as will be seen below, there are a few exceptions) a leaf (of a plant) (esp. one large and broad) (cf. bĕla-pạthᵃr, p. 104b, l. 38; padma-pᵒ, p. 682a, l. 17; ala-wạthᵃr, p. 22b, l. 44; bōñĕ-wᵒ, p. 115b, l. 39; dachĕ-wᵒ, p. 186a, l. 16; datᵃ̇rᵃ̇-wᵃ̇, p. 259a, l. 23; gula-wᵒ, p. 284a, l. 1; kā̃bayĕ-wᵒ, p. 382b, l. 49; khĕla-wᵒ, p. 397b, l. 23, and Śiv. 1802; khȧrⁱ-wⁱ, p. 410b, l. 49; muji-wᵒ, p. 558b, l. 20; pampōshĕ-wᵒ, p. 734a, l. 28, but pampōshĕ-pạtra, K. 926; pana-wᵒ, p. 735a, l. 23; pōshĕ-wᵒ, p. 779a, l. 47; pilⁱ-pilⁱ-wⁱ, s.v. pyulᵘ 1; pạtran-sag, p. 567a, l. 49, and Śiv. 1430) (Gr.M.; L. 457; Śiv. 1430, 1541, 1802; K. 926); the leaf of a manuscript, book, or the like (Gr.M.); a leaf of paper (cf khath-pᵒ, p. 422a, l. 47; kŏshĕla-pᵒ, p. 481a, l. 1) (Gr.M.); a letter, an epistle (K. 643-4). ¶ The fem. of this word is pạtᵃr 2 or pạtᵘ̈rᵘ̈ (q.v.), and indicates a leaf not of large size. It does not change to wạtᵃr or wạtᵘ̈rᵘ̈ in compounds.

m. (sg. dat. pạthᵃras), the floor, the bare floor (esp. of a room, house, or the like), the bare ground (cf. dā̃-pᵒ, p. 230b, l. 41) (Gr.M. pathur; Rām. 358, 409, 712, 1368, 1371, 1436; K. 1144; K.Pr. 35, 215). ¶ pạthᵃra kani adv. on the floor, down below. --kanyukᵘ -- adj. (f. --kanicᵘ̈ --), of, or belonging to, on the floor, of down below, down at the bottom. ¶ pạthᵃ̇rᵃ̇ or pathȧri adv. on the ground, on the floor (cf. pali ta pathȧri, p. 730a, l. 43) (Rām. 569).
f. (sg. dat. pạṭhᵃrüñᵃ), cleansing, remove dirt; the process of gutting (fishes); breaking in, training (esp. of some one ill-mannered).

conj. 1 (1 p.p. pạṭhᵃrôwᵃ), to cleanse, remove dirt; to gut (fishes); to break in, train, put in order (some ill-mannered or clumsy person or animal, or disorderly thing); to set oneself at, or to begin, any work; to arrange, put in order (cf. kakav pᵒ, p. 433a, l. 2). pạṭhᵃrôwᵃ-motᵃ perf. part. (f. pạṭhᵃrövᵃ-müʦᵃ), cleansed; (of work) set to at.

conj. 1 (1 p.p. pạṭhᵒrᵒ), to cleanse, remove dirt (cf. atha pᵒ, p. 61b, l. 34); to gut (fish) (Gr.Gr. 7); to break in, train, put into order (some ill-mannered or clumsy person, or animal, or disorderly thing). pạṭhᵒrᵒ-motᵒ perf. part. (f. pạṭhᵘ̈rᵘ̈-müʦᵘ̈), cleansed; gutted; trained, broken in.

f. a level piece of ground, a plateau (cf. gŏgᵃji-pᵃ, p. 279a, l. 21; and pathur) (L. 460, patri); the spreading or scattering about of things lying or fallen on the ground, the accumulation of such in a number of small heaps (cf. ḍāsa-pᵒ, p. 252a, l. 25; ḍōṭha-pᵒ, p. 258a, l. 5; and pathur).
f. a small village, a hamlet, in āra-pᵒ, p. 41a, l. 48, q.v. (prob. the same as the preceding).

f. a braid, or fillet, of hair, worn by women in a bow-shaped form on each side of the forehead, generally worn by prostitutes (El. paṭyini. According to El. it is worn by Paṇḍitānīs). pȧṭⁱñĕ thawañĕ f. pl. inf. to arrange hair in this fashion.
(? spelling and gend.) Aconitum heterophyllum, i.q. nar-māda, p. 646b, l. 14, q.v. (L. 74).
f. (sg. dat. pativrati), a devoted, faithful, and loyal wife (Śiv. 668; K. 1080, 1168).
f. a board with a handle, used by plasterers for consolidating or smoothing a plastered surface.

or pŏṭökⁱ f. a black wooden board with a handle, used like a slate in school, on which boys write with a white ink made of chalk; a small longish board with a handle, used for flogging schoolboys; a kind of tool used by carpenters for carving large boards, a kind of broad chisel. Cf. paṭākh, paṭösⁱ, and pŏṭösⁱ.
or pŏtolᵘ m. a large doll (cf. kāwa- patolᵘ, p. 495a, l. 30). Cf. pŏtᵘ̈jᵘ̈ and pŏtulᵘ.

or pŏṭôrᵘ  adj. (f. paṭörᵘ̈), one who is in the habit of chattering nonsensical absurdities (e.g. to amuse or to cheat people); one who talks through his (or her) nose, one who speaks nasally (cf. khǖ̃kha-pᵒ, p. 395b, l. 22).
f. a certain carpenter's tool used for carving patterns on a board. Cf. paṭökⁱ, paṭākh, and pŏṭösⁱ.
in pāṭösⁱ gaʦhun m.inf. to become gradually dissipated (of property, reputation, etc., which should be gradually amassed).
m. leaves of the Cinnamomum albiflorum (El.). Cf. pạtᵃr 2.
in pạtrakh-worᵘ m. a kind of thin round cake of wheat-flour cooked in clarified butter, esp. used in religious offerings.
m. (sg. dat. pātakas), going to hell, experiencing the tortures of hell; experiencing any evil-smelling and filthy place; suffering from any dangerous disease, trouble, or extreme poverty.
m. a mat made of pieces of wood and reeds built up together; a similarly made raft (for crossing a river or the like) (cf. nar-pᵒ, p. 646a, l. 49) (Gr.Gr. 35, 146). Cf. patᵘ̈jᵘ̈.
conj. 3 (2 p.p. paṭyōv), to obtain the result of a task undertaken, to achieve, succeed in one's efforts. paṭyō-motᵘ perf. part. (f. paṭyē-müʦᵘ̈), achieved.
in pātun pyonᵘ m.inf. grief, mourning, distress, to fall (upon a person), esp. from jealousy at another's success.
m. an official belonging to a village, whose duty it is to keep an account of the various crops reared by the villagers (El.; L. 400, 404, 426, 435). Cf. paṭhwörⁱ.

adj. (f. patimᵘ̈), posterior, hindermost (cf. ami-pᵒ, p. 55a, l. 5) (Gr.Gr. 152; Rām. 13, 570; K. 187); latter, last, last of all (El. also patum; Gr.M.; H. v, 8; K.Pr. 167); that which is past and done with, former, of olden time (Śiv. 425, 437, 1756; Rām. 1693). --brū̃ṭhyumᵘ -- adj. (f. patimᵘ̈ brū̃ṭhimᵘ̈), last and first, prior and subsequent, preceding and following; hence, met. the whole (from first to last). --pahar -- m. the last watch (of the night), the watch before dawn (Gr.Gr. 157; Śiv. 628, 1712; K.Pr. 176). --sāth -- m. the final moment, the last time, the hour of death. ¶ patim paharukᵘ adj.
